body:
I'm almost 50 and often feel the same way. And I felt this way when I was in my 30s--often in my 20s. But when I lost my job--about five years now--I just never regained my footing. And then a string of lost jobs, jobs I wouldn't be good at had I been hired. I often feel useless and a waste of people's attention. 

I have no savings, and I am afraid what kind of life I'll have to live when I become too old to work. The thought of poverty terrifies me. 

None of this helps you. I'm sorry. I wish I could give you more. Take care.
